The '''Imperial Research and Development Station T-1583''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located in the [[Tamarin sector/Legends|Tamarin sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="PC" />

==History==
The station was invaded by [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Sard Nightbringer]]'s forces sometimes after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. They cleaned out the base and stole an experimental [[Personal energy shield/Legends|personal energy shield]].<ref name="PC" />

==Appearances==
*{{WEGCite|story=The Art of Betrayal|book=The Politics of Contraband|reprint=1}} {{1stm}}
